outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Sexual Harassment page
outreach_draft.body:
Hi Jeremy,

I noticed Levine Injury Law’s current site presents motor-vehicle accidents, slip-and-falls, workplace injuries, and sexual harassment together in the same general website conversation, while sexual harassment does not appear to have its own focused destination.

That matters because someone dealing with workplace sexual harassment arrives with a very different problem, urgency, and set of questions than an accident client. A dedicated page would give that person a clearer path from the moment they land on the site, while also creating more focused context for Google and for AI systems trying to understand exactly what the firm handles.

I’d use sexual harassment as the first mockup because it is explicitly offered today yet is the clearest materially different journey still sharing the broader homepage experience.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
